families.information_cutoff_semantics: Only direct ETHBTC hourly rows whose timestamp is at or before information_cutoff_utc.
families.source_provider: Binance direct ETHBTC spot retained hourly rows
families.transformation_definition: Direct ETHBTC closes, 0.0300 level, 168h window and latest side. Prospective tournament permission is true iff latest side is ABOVE. Persistence metadata remains descriptive; no synthetic ratio.

families.information_cutoff_semantics: Membership and aggregate frozen by retrieval timestamp before observation; first eligible capture must be at/after prospective freeze start; no hindsight universe membership.
families.transformation_definition: Prospective-only BREADTH_MAJORITY_SURVIVAL_PROSPECTIVE_v1: BROAD_MAJORITY iff advancers > decliners in the point-in-time frozen owner universe; permission true iff BROAD_MAJORITY. No claim of legacy STRONG/PARTIAL/WEAK equivalence.

families.information_cutoff_semantics: Only settled complete UTC dates known before observation. Source rows are never interpolated/current-day backfilled. Latest settled state may remain the prospective decision state until the next settled print.
families.source_version_convention: CMC_DIRECT_SOURCE_CONVENTION = BTC market cap / total market cap tracked by CoinMarketCap; not TradingView CRYPTOCAP:BTC.D top-125
families.transformation_definition: Prospective-only BTCD_CMC_THREE_PRINT_PATH_PROSPECTIVE_v1: latest three settled CMC BTC.D closes a,b,c; FALLING_PATH iff c < b < a; RISING_RECLAIM iff b < a and c > b; MIXED_PATH otherwise. Permission true iff FALLING_PATH. No legacy TradingView equivalence.

families.exact_blocker: Exact ETF_FLOW_QUALITY transform and decision mapping require prospective preregistration.
families.information_cutoff_semantics: Only finalized sessions verified before observation; revision timing retained; unknown cells remain unknown.
families.source_version_convention: FARSIDE_ETF_OWNER_SNAPSHOT_v4; finalized sessions; header schema; total parity; unknown fund cells not imputed
families.transformation_definition: UNFROZEN. Existing qualitative flow labels are not an exact ETF_FLOW_QUALITY transform.

families.exact_blocker: No frozen liquidation_raw/reclaim_raw owner+transform. OI/funding/taker cannot substitute for liquidation clearance/reclaim.
families.information_cutoff_semantics: Only hourly owner fields captured at/before information cutoff; source failures stay missing.
families.source_version_convention: Hourly sequence v2.2 OI, OI change, funding, long-short, taker-flow and price/OI state
families.transformation_definition: UNFROZEN for liquidation/reclaim. Existing OI/funding/taker fields remain raw context only.

families.exact_blocker: Stablecoin supply/liquidity is not deployment or parking; separate deployment/parking owner/definition required.
families.information_cutoff_semantics: Owner timestamp before observation; no interpolation/forward-fill unless source contract explicitly allows it.
families.transformation_definition: UNFROZEN for deployment/parking. Existing owner measures supply/liquidity and chain distribution only.

families.exact_blocker: CFGI lane exists, but latest audited week has no usable source/engine/version-bound score.
families.information_cutoff_semantics: Only source-identified CFGI captures with engine/version and retrieval timestamp before observation.
families.transformation_definition: UNFROZEN. Latest audited W34 summary is SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE with capture_count=0. Alternative.me is forbidden as substitute.

families.exact_blocker: Full Stack decision contract cannot freeze until constituent reproducible family decision contracts are enumerated and version-bound.
families.information_cutoff_semantics: Every included component must have owner+transform frozen before row cutoff; no later family injected into earlier rows.
families.source_provider: Dynamic row-time reproducible Shadow Registry family set
families.source_version_convention: Exact family/version map frozen on every eligible row
families.transformation_definition: Full Stack is the set of reproducible research-eligible families present and version-bound at the row cutoff. Missing family remains missing and is never zero.

freeze_prerequisite: No candidate row is eligible before the relevant owner, transform and candidate-decision contract are frozen in merged Git history.
